metadata.name: Resync Protocol
metadata.description: Procedure for synchronizing architecture and implementation when drift is detected or iteration budget exceeded
metadata.purpose: Prevent architecture drift and maintain design intent throughout development

iteration_budget_exceeded.description: P3<->P4 loop count exceeds configured budget

major_drift.description: Drift is so significant that functional analysis may need revisiting

step_1_halt.name: Halt Current Work
step_1_halt.llm_instruction: STOP current development task. A resync is required because: {{trigger_reason}}

step_2_detect.name: Detect Drift
step_2_detect.description: Run drift detection tools to quantify divergence

added_functions: functions in impl not in arch
removed_functions: functions in arch not in impl

step_2_detect.llm_instruction: Run drift detection. Compare current implementation to architecture_anchor.

step_3_compare.name: Present Comparison
step_3_compare.description: Show user the difference between design and implementation
step_3_compare.llm_instruction: Present the drift analysis to the user clearly. Show what was designed vs what exists.

step_4_resolve.name: Mode-Specific Resolution
step_4_resolve.description: Handle drift according to development mode

flexible_mode.llm_instruction: In FLEXIBLE mode: Update architecture to match reality. Document WHY each change was made.

options.name: Revert Implementation
options.description: Undo implementation changes to match architecture
steps: Identify implementation changes that caused drift

options.name: Create Change Request
steps: Document each drift item as change request

rigid_mode.llm_instruction: In RIGID mode: Present options A (revert) or B (change request). User must choose.

step_5_update_anchor.name: Update Architecture Anchor
step_5_update_anchor.description: If architecture was updated (flexible mode), regenerate anchor
actions: Record resync event in anchor history
step_5_update_anchor.llm_instruction: Regenerate architecture_anchor with new checksums and updated design intent.

step_7_continue.name: Continue or Escalate
step_7_continue.description: Return to development or escalate to earlier phase

decision_logic.if_major_drift: Return to P2 to revise architecture allocation
decision_logic.if_fundamental_drift: Return to P1 to revise functional analysis

flexible_mode_workflow.philosophy: Implementation reveals requirements; architecture should reflect reality

rigid_mode_workflow.philosophy: Architecture is approved; implementation must conform
steps: 3. User chooses: Revert OR Change Request
4B. If Change Request: document and await approval

discovered_requirements_integration.description: Handle requirements discovered during P3/P4 that were tracked

flexible_mode.action: Include in architecture update during resync
process: Read all DR-* entries with architecture_updated=false

rigid_mode.action: Convert to change requests if not already
process: DR-* entries should already be CR-* entries

resync_history.description: Log all resync events for audit trail

when_resync_triggered: - FLEXIBLE: 'I will update the architecture to match implementation. Please confirm.'
- RIGID: 'Choose: (A) Revert implementation or (B) Create change request'
critical_reminders: User confirmation required before architecture updates
Always document WHY changes were made
Always regenerate anchor after architecture changes
